definitions.ask: Which gesture should extract a section and inline it back?
definitions.why: Keeps the project gesture's refusals intact; Ctrl+Shift+E is verified unbound

choices.label: Ctrl+Shift+E toggles prose sections; Ctrl+Shift+Alt+N keeps its task/project meaning
Ctrl+Shift+Alt+N also extracts on section lines and inlines in prose notes

definitions.ask: What should extraction leave under the heading it keeps?
definitions.why: Renders cleanly and stays a one-note drawer for later project reversal

choices.label: One `- [[stem|Title]]` bullet that renders as a plain link
One `- ![[stem]]` bullet that reads in place but repeats the promoted headings

definitions.ask: How should extraction treat text above a note's first heading?
definitions.why: One typed heading does the same job and keeps every round trip heading-anchored

choices.label: Refuse with a hint to type a heading first, so every extraction has a real heading
Extract it under a synthesized `## Overview` stub that inline removes again

definitions.ask: Add a generated ## Prose catalog to areas and projects, with the reversal catalog-skip fix?
definitions.why: Stubs already show extracted notes in place, and Ctrl+= finds children by parent

definitions.ask: Add a Prose Section glossary term to SASE memory?
